correctness.rationale: With all interactions fixed, each unnormalized 2-by-2 pair-table entry after summing other spins is affine in z=e^(2h), as only one binary spectator field changes. The pair covariance is 4 det(M)/total(M)^2, so its sign has at most two changes. For three spins the exact cosh product identity yields the displayed quadratic A z²+B z+C; signs A,C are signs(a+d),signs(a-d), giving root cases and tangent boundary. The identically zero case A=C=B=0 is equivalent to a=d=0 and bc=0. For a=ln2/4,b=ln2,c=-ln2,d=0, Q=z²−193 z/16+1 has two positive reciprocal roots (193±15√161)/32; the t-conditional odds ratios are 2 in both sectors. Independent direct eight-state Gibbs enumeration tested 21 values of h,h1,h2 and matched covariance sign to Q. Finite checks support but do not establish the general-N proof.
residual_risks: One varying field at a binary spectator spin, fixed all other interactions; cannot infer multi-field paths, continuous spins or thermodynamic transitions.
